licensing.title: Licensing
licensing.first_paragraph: Original Stormtrooper Coffee is officially licensed by Shepperton Design Studios. Products developed under the licence are inspired by the actual moulds produced by Andrew Ainsworth to make the iconic helmets and costumes back in 1976.
licensing.second_paragraph: Original Stormtrooper Coffee is true to the original design and approved by Andrew himself… the authentic manufacturer.
licensing.approval_alt: Shepperton Design Studios seal of approval and Andrew Ainsworth signature

product.heading: One coffee. Two formats.
product.intro: The same freshly roasted coffee, available in a 250g bag or a limited 155g collector’s tin.
product.unavailable: World Order Coffee is temporarily unavailable.

coffee_details.intro: The story and essential information behind the current release.
coffee_details.coffee_text: Information about the current coffee, its growing region and the flavours customers can expect in the cup.
coffee_details.producer_text: Information about the farm, cooperative or producer behind this coffee and what makes this release distinctive.

subscription.heading: Two coffees. One delivery. Every two months.
subscription.intro: We work in rolling two-month cycles. Whenever you join, your delivery contains that month’s coffee and the following month’s coffee before its individual release.
subscription.early_text: Join in January and you receive January’s Coffee A plus February’s unreleased Coffee B. Join in February and you receive February’s Coffee A plus March’s unreleased Coffee B. Every subscriber always receives early access to the following month’s coffee.
subscription.included_text: Two different coffees in your chosen format—one of each release.
subscription.frequency_text: Your first two-coffee delivery is based on the month you join. Future combined deliveries continue every two months to reduce delivery journeys and packaging.
subscription.saving_text: Save 20% on the coffee. Your existing subscription shipping charge is added separately.
subscription.control_text: Pause, skip or cancel through your customer account before the next billing date.
subscription.purchase_intro: Both formats contain the same two featured coffees. Choose paper bags to make it all about the brew or choose the tin option for a memorable keepsake after your coffee has finished.
subscription.option_note: Two different coffees · delivered every two months
subscription.terms: Renews every two months using your saved payment and delivery details until paused or cancelled. Shipping is charged separately.
subscription.unavailable: The coffee subscription is temporarily unavailable.
subscription.faq_coffees_a: Each delivery contains two different coffees: the release currently available on the website and the following month’s release before its general launch. The exact future coffee remains a surprise until delivery.
subscription.faq_billing_q: How often will I be charged?
subscription.faq_billing_a: You will be charged once every two months for your selected two-pack, plus the applicable subscription shipping charge.
subscription.faq_cancel_q: How do I pause, skip or cancel?
subscription.faq_cancel_a: Open My Account and manage the subscription before your next billing date. Changes apply to future deliveries and do not affect an order already processed.
subscription.faq_shipping_a: No. The existing subscription shipping charge is calculated and added separately during checkout. Combining two coffees into one delivery reduces shipping frequency.
